title: Debt counselling and debt review are the same thing #DebtReview
text:
Three words that sound alike. Debt consolidation is a new loan: you borrow one big amount and pay off your other debts. Debt counselling is the help you get from a debt counsellor registered with the National Credit Regulator. Debt review is the legal process that counsellor puts you into, under the National Credit Act. So debt counselling and debt review are two sides of the same thing, and you really have two roads: a new loan, or a legal plan.

Full guide: "Debt Review vs Debt Consolidation vs Debt Counselling: Which One Fits You? (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.

Sources
- National Credit Act 34 of 2005, section 86 (debt review): https://lawlibrary.org.za/akn/za/act/2005/34/eng%402021-06-30
- National Credit Regulator, register of debt counsellors: https://www.ncr.org.za
